subject: Re: Addendum: Operational Access & Key Retention for Private Deployment
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: John Sanborn <j.sanborn@acmehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Operational access and evidence for private deployment

David —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal asked us to surface two items before we can sign: 1) a narrow operator-access exhibit that limits Redwood tech team console access to a timeboxed witness/validation window, and 2) retention and handback terms for any ephemeral keys or test snapshots used during setup. They suggested an escrow-like acceptance attestation rather than full code escrow.

I've attached a short list of proposed redlines from our side (ACME_Redlines_20261214.docx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
- Provide a maximum 8-hour, auditable console session window for operator validation (no standing access)
- Produce a signed attestation after the validation window confirming no retained keys or snapshots were copied off-site
- Accept an Order Form Exhibit that prescribes deletion timelines for ephemeral KV caches and setup credentials

Happy to hop on a call with legal if helpful.

Best,
John Sanborn
VP, IT Delivery | Acme Health

--- Message 2 ---
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: John Sanborn <j.sanborn@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational access and evidence for private deployment

John —

Thanks — we can accommodate all three asks but want to propose precise language so it maps to our operational controls. High-level replies: 
- Timeboxed operator validation: yes. We can include an Exhibit (Operator Witness Window) limiting Redwood engineer console access to a single contiguous window up to 8 hours during a mutually scheduled appointment. Access will be via a recorded bastion with MFA and session logs retained for 90 days.
- Signed attestation: we can provide a standard "Validation Completion Attestation" signed by our SOC lead that confirms no persistent keys or customer data were exported during the window. The attestation will reference session logs and the runbook executed.
- Ephemeral KV/credential deletion: we can commit to deletion of ephemeral credentials and cache copies within 48 hours after validation, with an audit entry and a supporting artifact (runbook excerpt).

I'll loop in Marissa (Legal) and Laura (Solutions) to draft Exhibit language that maps to the Order Form. If that sounds good, we'll prepare targeted redlines and a short one-page runbook snippet to attach.

-David
David Kim
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 (internal) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational access and evidence for private deployment

Team —

Draft approach to push back / accept with carve:
1) Operator Window: agree to 8h maximum. Add explicit limits: single session per deployment, named engineer(s), session recording stored immutable for 90 days, redacted for customer PII before Redwood review if any PII surfaced.
2) Attestation scope: limit to actions executed during the window and reference log hashes; do NOT commit to attestation about broader system state (no affirmation about absence of retained copies outside Redwood control).
3) KV/credentials deletion: commit to deletion within 48 hours but add standard exception for forensic hold triggered by a lawful process; provide notice and an updated schedule if hold is invoked.

I'll prepare draft Exhibit language and attach a one-page Operational_Runbook_Diff.pdf that shows the exact runbook excerpt we can share post-signing. Also recommend we offer a DocuSign attestation template (one-off signature) rather than embedding long wording into the MSA.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Acme Health Legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: John Sanborn <j.sanborn@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational access and evidence for private deployment

David / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick answers. A few follow-ups from our counsel: 
- We need explicit language that the attestation will be signed within five business days of the validation window closing.
- The attestation must include the session log hash and list of actions performed (high-level; not verbatim commands) to be useful for audit.
- Deletion exception: acceptable but request a notification window of 24 hours to Acme procurement and a proposed mitigation timeline.

Attached are our lightly-edited redlines. Can Redwood produce a clean Exhibit text and a comment matrix we can iterate on? We aim to have a signed Order Form + Exhibit executed by end of month.

Regards,
Acme Health Legal

--- Message 5 ---
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Acme Health Legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>, John Sanborn <j.sanborn@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational access and evidence for private deployment

Appreciate the specifics — we can agree to the five-business-day attestation turnaround and will include session log hash + a high-level action summary. On the deletion exception, we will notify Acme procurement within 24 hours and propose a mitigation plan within seven business days; we'll include that language in Exhibit B.

Action items: 
- Marissa: produce an Exhibit B draft + comment matrix (ETA EOD 12/17).
- Laura & Hannah: prepare the runbook excerpt and the session-recording retention note (ETA 12/17).
- David: draft DocuSign attestation template and hubspot link for deal record.

I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call for Monday to walk the exhibit if needed.

-David
David Kim
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced: ACME_Redlines_20261214.docx (redlines), Operational_Runbook_Diff.pdf (runbook excerpt), OrderForm_ExhibitB_v3.xlsx (exhibit cost/term table)]
